items.q: What is the oxidation number of Mn in MnO₄⁻?
items.qAf: Wat is die oksidasiegetal van Mn in MnO₄⁻?
items.explain: O is −2 each: 4 × (−2) = −8. The ion charge is −1, so Mn = +7.
items.explainAf: O is elk −2: 4 × (−2) = −8. Die ioonlading is −1, dus is Mn = +7.

items.q: In the reaction Zn + Cu²⁺ → Zn²⁺ + Cu, zinc is:
items.qAf: In die reaksie Zn + Cu²⁺ → Zn²⁺ + Cu word sink:
items.explain: Zinc goes from 0 to +2, losing electrons, so it is oxidised.
items.explainAf: Sink gaan van 0 na +2, verloor elektrone, dus word dit geoksideer.

items.explain: Oxidation is loss of electrons; reduction is gain of electrons.
items.explainAf: Oksidasie is verlies van elektrone; reduksie is opname van elektrone.

items.q: The reducing agent in a redox reaction is:
items.qAf: Die reduseermiddel in ’n redoksreaksie is die:
items.explain: The reducing agent donates electrons, so it is itself oxidised.
items.explainAf: Die reduseermiddel skenk elektrone, dus word dit self geoksideer.

items.q: In a voltaic cell, electrons flow from the:
items.qAf: In ’n galvaniese sel vloei elektrone van die:
items.explain: Electrons flow through the external circuit from the anode (oxidation) to the cathode (reduction).
items.explainAf: Elektrone vloei deur die eksterne stroombaan van die anode (oksidasie) na die katode (reduksie).
